name: Custom / forked engine
qwen_support: Depends entirely on the fork. These entries exist because stock engines cannot serve the configuration.
gotchas: Not portable: the weights usually only load in the author's engine.
Reproducibility is the weakest tier in the directory. Treat claimed numbers as unverified until someone else runs them.
Always check the license of the engine separately from the license of the weights.

install.note: A fork has no standard install. Follow the recipe's own steps and repository.
